Optimized database queries and streamlined new staff onboarding, significantly enhancing team efficiency, reducing response times, and accelerating staff productivity.

## Projects

### Taimako.AI
AI-powered customer support platform using an agentic RAG engine. Processes knowledge base documents to provide accurate, context-aware responses via an embeddable chat widget or WhatsApp. Features a business dashboard, human escalation, and subscription billing.
- Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Google ADK, RAG, Docker, AWS
- Live: https://taimako-your-ai-whatsapp-partner.onrender.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/stenwire/Taimako.AI

### Vendkit.IO
Smart vending platform that enables businesses, landlords, and property managers to automate and manage prepaid utilities like electricity, water, and gas.
- Stack: Frappe, Django Rest Framework, React
- Live: https://vendkit.io/

### NaijaFarmHand — AI Agent
Intelligent assistant built with Google's ADK providing contextual farming guidance for Nigerian agriculture.
- Stack: Python, Google ADK, RAG
- GitHub: https://github.com/stenwire/NaijaFarmHand-Agent

### Car Booking API
High-performance vehicle reservation system with real-time availability tracking, secure payment processing, and driver management.
- Stack: Python, Django, Redis, Docker, AWS
- GitHub: https://github.com/stenwire/AutoGo
